फिल्मी गलियारों से आ गई है एकदम गरमा-गरम और मसालेदार खबर! 🔥
शाहरुख खान ने अपनी आने वाली फिल्म King का नया लुक शेयर कर दिया है। 🎬
उन्होंने इंस्टाग्राम पर कैप्शन लिखा कि आज फिर याद आया... कातिल नहीं… आशिक हूं… #KING
यह फिल्म सीधे सिनेमाघरों में 24 दिसंबर 2026 को रिलीज होगी। 📅
इस फिल्म में शाहरुख खान लीड रोल में नजर आएंगे और इसका डायरेक्शन सिद्धार्थ आनंद कर रहे हैं। ✨
फिल्म में सुहाना खान, दीपिका पादुकोण, अभिषेक बच्चन और रानी मुखर्जी जैसे कलाकार भी हैं। 🌟
यह प्रोजेक्ट शाहरुख की बेटी सुहाना के साथ उनकी पहली फिल्म है, जिन्होंने साल 2023 में The Archies से एक्टिंग डेब्यू किया था। 🍿
क्या आप शाहरुख और सुहाना को एक साथ बड़े पर्दे पर देखने के लिए सुपर एक्साइटेड हैं? 🤔

ctx.title: King new poster out: Shah Rukh Khan plays a ‘lover’ again at 60
ctx.summary: Directed by Siddharth Anand, King also stars Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan and Rani Mukerji.
ctx.text:
Shah Rukh Khan has unveiled his look from his upcoming film King. The actor shared a new poster of the film on social media and also announced its theatrical release date. The film is set to release in cinemas on December 24, 2026.
Sharing the poster on Instagram, Shah Rukh captioned it, “Aaj phir yaad aaya... Qaatil nahi… Aashiq hoon… #KING In cinemas 24.12.26.”
King stars Shah Rukh Khan in the lead role and is directed by Siddharth Anand. The film also features Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, Abhishek Bachchan and Rani Mukerji, among others. The project marks Shah Rukh's first film with his daughter Suhana, who made her acting debut with The Archies in 2023. The film is scheduled to arrive in theatres on December 24, 2026.
Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows.

A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
